segments.name: subscription business
segments.description: Provides direct-to-consumer medical insurance for cats and dogs to pet parents in North America and Continental Europe on a recurring subscription basis.
segments.evidence: We generate revenue in our subscription business segment primarily through insurance premiums, which we refer to as subscription payments, from direct-to-consumer products.
